dogecoin.text: 3⃣  A coin like $TRUMP might see sudden spikes whenever there’s a news cycle about Trump—but could just as easily languish when attention moves elsewhere. A few memecoins (like $Doge) manage to hang on by building strong community support but it’s comparatively rare.

📊 Market Shift Analysis: Before & After $TRUMP Launch
🔵 Pre-Launch
Policy-driven rally: $BTC surged on regulatory optimism, ETF inflows
Memecoin stagnation: Decline in $DOGE and legacy memecoins.
Capital rotation: Funds shifted to AI/RWA sectors.
